project: GOLD5 — Gold Engagement Ring Online Buying Checklist
pledge: NO HALLUCINATIONS: every row links to its source; unconfirmed values are left blank and flagged unverified; nothing is inferred or invented.

entries.item: Gold purity — confirm the karat (10K, 14K, 18K, etc.)
entries.whatToVerify: Karat mark states how much pure gold the piece contains (24-part system; 18K = 18/24 gold, 14K = 14/24 gold)
Listing explicitly says solid gold; not plated, vermeil, gold-filled, gold overlay, or gold-tone
10K/14K/18K stamp plus a maker's/manufacturer's mark; FTC warns: no trademark with the karat mark = don't buy
entries.notes: U.S. has no mandatory government assay office; stamp alone is not proof of purity

entries.whatToVerify: Ring weight in grams provided by seller
entries.notes: Conversion factor verified (1 oz t = 31.1034768 g); specific ring weights are seller-provided, not listed here

entries.whatToVerify: Independent reviews and complaints; real business contact information
entries.notes: No government-run jeweler rating database found; FTC method is search-engine-based (name + complaint/review)

entries.whatToVerify: Price compared with ring's gold weight and current gold value; unusually cheap = red flag
entries.notes: Live spot prices vary by dealer; no product prices are listed or inferred on this site

entries.whatToVerify: Return after receiving and inspecting; check exclusions on resized/custom rings
entries.notes: No general federal return right for online sales; Cooling-Off Rule covers door-to-door/temporary-location sales only

entries.whatToVerify: Credit card for purchase protection; avoid irreversible payment methods
Keep listing, receipt, description, and seller's gold-purity claims
Independent jeweler verifies purity and weight before wearing/resizing
entries.notes: Guidance from trade association/consumer page; not a codified federal requirement

entries.whatToVerify: Ask for XRF testing or another professional gold-purity test; don't rely solely on the stamp
entries.notes: No government source found mandating or describing consumer XRF testing — flagged

entries.whatToVerify: If the seller won't allow independent verification or return, don't buy

flags.issue: No U.S. federal/state government source found requiring consumer independent-jeweler verification
flags.disposition: Unverified guidance — kept on site, marked unverified

flags.issue: No government source found mandating/describing consumer XRF testing; industry/vendor sources only
flags.disposition: Unverified guidance — flagged, not presented as regulation

flags.issue: Karats stamp + trademark required, but no mandatory government assay office in the U.S.
flags.disposition: Noted as consumer limitation throughout the site

flags.issue: Seller reputation relies on FTC search-engine method plus state attorney general
flags.disposition: Method documented; no seller names or ratings listed

flags.item: No general federal return right for online sales
flags.issue: Online returns depend on seller's written policy; Cooling-Off Rule is narrowly scoped
flags.disposition: Stated explicitly on Return Policy page

flags.issue: Prices change constantly; no current spot price claimed on this site
flags.disposition: Calculator is user-entered; any build-time reference is labeled with source and time
